raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Closes #44044.

`perplexity-ai/pplx-decider-v1.1-27b` ships a 255-row decision readout (`readout.safetensors`, `[255, 5120]`) instead of an LM head. The current loader scatters those rows into a zero-filled `[248320, 5120]` vocabulary head (≈2.368 GiB in BF16) and projects every scored position onto the full vocabulary. This PR adds an **opt-in** mode that keeps the native readout (≈2.49 MiB) and scores the pooled hidden state directly.

## Modifications

Enabled with:

```bash
--json-model-override-args '{"sglang_pplx_compact_readout":true}'
```

- **`layers/compact_decision_head.py`** (new): `CompactDecisionPooler` — LAST-token pooling of the backbone's final hidden state, then the native `[num_codes, hidden]` readout. No vocabulary head, logits buffer or sampler conversion.
- **`models/qwen3_vl.py`, `models/qwen3_5.py`**: `build_lm_head=False` skips `lm_head`/`LogitsProcessor` construction; the existing readout loader fills the compact head before the scatter branch. Backbone, vision tower and mRoPE are unchanged.
- **`configs/model_config.py`**: parses the flag (must be a JSON boolean), requires a decision checkpoint, rejects combination with a joint schema head, and marks the model non-generative.
- **`arg_groups/model_hook.py`**: TP=PP=1, unquantized native impl only; LoRA, speculative decoding and MIS are rejected. Resolves `is_embedding=True` and disables radix cache / chunked prefill.
- **`managers/tokenizer_manager*.py`, `entrypoints/systemone/serving.py`, `entrypoints/openai/serving_decisions.py`**: route compact checkpoints through the embedding path; generation/chat requests and unsupported pooling/scoring options are rejected before scheduling.
- **Docs**: a Configuration Tips entry on the PPLX-Decider-v1.1-27B cookbook page.
- The trained-protocol functions (`_encoded_decider_questions`, `_decider_question`, `_answer`, `_choice_confidence`, `_score_confidence`) are unchanged. Without the flag, the existing vocabulary-head path is untouched.
- Tests: `test/registered/unit/layers/test_compact_decision_head.py`, `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/systemone/test_compact_decider.py` (new), plus cases in `test/registered/unit/configs/test_model_config.py`.

## Accuracy Tests

**Setup.** 1× H20 96GB, CUDA 13.0, torch 2.14.1+cu130, flashinfer 0.7.1, sglang-kernel 0.4.9, transformers 5.19.0, this branch on `7ff3a112`. Two servers that differ only in the flag: `--attention-backend flashinfer --dtype bfloat16 --tp-size 1 --context-length 8192 --max-total-tokens 8192`, prefill CUDA graphs enabled on both. The same requests were sent to each through `/v1/systemone`.

**Unit tests** (`test_compact_decision_head.py`, `entrypoints/systemone/`, `test_model_config.py`): 34 passed, 20 subtests passed, 0 failed. The existing `test_joint_schema.py` also passes (10 passed, 8 subtests).

**Baseline (flag off) vs compact (flag on)**, max absolute probability difference per request:

| Request | Input tokens | Questions | Max prob diff | Top choice |
|---|---:|---|---:|---|
| req0 | 205 | choice + noul | 2.3e-10 | same |
| mid_short (concurrent) | 179 | noul | 6.9e-09 | — |
| mid_medium (concurrent) | 1393 | choice | 3.6e-12 | same |
| mid_long (concurrent) | 2679 | choice | 3.4e-09 | same |
| mid_mixed (concurrent) | 5346 | choice + noul | 6.5e-09 | same |
| long8k | 7844 | choice | 4.9e-12 | same |

No top-choice flips. The four `mid_*` requests were sent concurrently as one variable-length batch.

Not yet covered: parity against the model's reference (transformers) implementation, image inputs, and the FA3 / TRT-LLM attention backends.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

**Memory** (`Load weight end`, as reported by SGLang):

| | Weight memory |
|---|---:|
| Baseline | 51.05 GB |
| Compact | 48.71 GB |
| Saved | 2.34 GB (expected ≈2.37 GiB) |

`--max-total-tokens` was pinned on both sides so the freed memory is not absorbed into a larger KV pool.

**Latency** (p50 over 100 rounds, ms):

| Request | Baseline | Compact |
|---|---:|---:|
| req0 | 102.8 | 101.8 |
| mid_short | 948.4 | 928.3 |
| mid_medium | 2793.6 | 2800.3 |
| mid_long | 2792.7 | 2799.9 |
| mid_mixed | 3876.6 | 3885.8 |
| long8k | 3275.9 | 3283.6 |

Latency is unchanged within noise: the baseline projects onto the vocabulary only for the last position of each request, which is small next to the backbone, so the benefit is memory, not speed. The concurrent `mid_*` latencies most likely include queueing, because their combined 9,597 tokens exceed the pinned 8,192-token pool.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -178,6 +178,7 @@ Perplexity reports a Decision Index of 61.56 for v1.1, up from 56.4 for v1:
 - **Prompt length.** Like v1, the model was trained on question prompts of up to 8,192 tokens, and the reference code refuses longer ones. SGLang serves longer prompts in one pass, but their accuracy is untested.
 - **Attention backend.** On GB300, Auto resolves to the TRT-LLM kernel with 64-token pages. `--attention-backend flashinfer` and `--attention-backend triton` matched the reference implementation as closely, with the same top option on 99.8% of the accuracy items. The H200 path has not been run yet.
 - **Speed.** One GB300 reads about 27,000 prompt tokens per second once batches are full, the same as v1. Measured back to back on the same GPU against v1's recipe, v1.1 was within 2% on short questions and four-question requests, and an 8K-token state saturated 6% lower (3.13 against 3.32 requests per second), because noncausal attention computes the full attention matrix in its 16 full-attention layers instead of half of it.
+- **Compact readout (opt-in).** The checkpoint's readout has 255 rows, but by default SGLang scatters them into a vocabulary-sized output head of about 2.37 GiB in BF16. Launch with `--json-model-override-args '{"sglang_pplx_compact_readout":true}'` to score the last position with the 255-row readout directly. On one H20 this lowered weight memory from 51.05 GB to 48.71 GB, probabilities matched the default path to within 7e-9 on prompts of up to 7,844 tokens, and latency was unchanged. The mode requires TP=PP=1 and unquantized weights, and rejects LoRA, speculative decoding and MIS. Image inputs have not been validated with it yet.
 - **More GPUs.** The backbone and prompt sizes are v1's, so the [v1 page's scaling measurements](/cookbook/autoregressive/Perplexity/PPLX-Decider-v1-27B#2-configuration-tips) are the reference: data-parallel replicas (`--dp-size N`) for throughput, tensor parallelism only for latency on long prompts. They were not repeated for v1.1.
 - **Upgrading from v1.** Re-check any thresholds you tuned on v1 probabilities: v1.1 has a different temperature and changed its top answer on 8% of the Belebele and WinoGrande items.

+"""Compact last-token readout for PPLX decision checkpoints."""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.pooler import (
+    EmbeddingPoolerOutput,
+    PoolingType,
+    pool_hidden_states,
+)
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch
+
+
+class CompactDecisionPooler(nn.Module):
+    """Pool before the readout, without constructing a vocabulary-sized output.
+
+    Rows retain decision_config.json's code order. Candidate selection and
+    calibration belong to the serving layer, after this unnormalized readout.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, num_codes: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.readout = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_codes, bias=False)
+
+    def forward(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, forward_batch: "ForwardBatch"
+    ) -> EmbeddingPoolerOutput:
+        pooled = pool_hidden_states(PoolingType.LAST, hidden_states, forward_batch)
+        return EmbeddingPoolerOutput(
+            embeddings=self.readout(pooled).float(),
+            pooled_hidden_states=(
+                pooled if forward_batch.return_pooled_hidden_states else None
+            ),
+        )

+"""Compact PPLX serving keeps trained candidate ordering, media and API guards."""
+
+import asyncio
+import json
+import math
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.systemone.protocol import SystemOneRequest
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.systemone.serving import SystemOneServing, _view
+from sglang.srt.managers.io_struct import EmbeddingReqInput, GenerateReqInput
+from sglang.srt.managers.tokenizer_manager import TokenizerManager
+from sglang.srt.managers.tokenizer_manager_score_mixin import TokenizerManagerScoreMixin
+from sglang.srt.utils import ImageData
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=3, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class ReadoutManager:
+    def __init__(self, rows):
+        self.rows = rows
+        self.requests = []
+        self.served_model_name = "pplx"
+
+    async def generate_request(self, request, raw_request):
+        self.requests.append(request)
+        yield [
+            {"embedding": row, "meta_info": {"prompt_tokens": 20 + i}}
+            for i, row in enumerate(self.rows)
+        ]
+
+
+def handler(rows):
+    result = SystemOneServing.__new__(SystemOneServing)
+    result.tokenizer_manager = ReadoutManager(rows)
+    result.decision_config = {"token_ids": list(range(1000, 1255)), "temperature": 2.0}
+    result.compact_decision_readout = True
+    result.joint_head_config = None
+    return result
+
+
+class TestCompactDecider(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_candidates_selected_before_temperature_and_softmax(self):
+        row = [0.0, 2.0, -2.0] + [1000.0] * 252
+        serving = handler([row, row])
+        encoded = iter([([10, 11], [1000, 1001, 1002], []), ([12], [1001, 1000], [])])
+        scores, tokens = asyncio.run(serving._score_compact_decider(encoded, None))
+        expected = [math.exp(x) for x in (0.0, 1.0, -1.0)]
+        total = sum(expected)
+        for value, reference in zip(scores[0], expected):
+            self.assertAlmostEqual(value, reference / total)
+        self.assertAlmostEqual(scores[1][0], math.exp(1) / (1 + math.exp(1)))
+        self.assertEqual(tokens, 41)
+        request = serving.tokenizer_manager.requests[0]
+        self.assertIsInstance(request, EmbeddingReqInput)
+        self.assertEqual(request.input_ids, [[10, 11], [12]])
+        self.assertIsNone(request.image_data)
+
+    def test_images_remain_attached_to_each_rendered_prompt(self):
+        image_a = ImageData(url="data:image/png;base64,first")
+        image_b = ImageData(url="data:image/png;base64,second")
+        images = [[image_a, image_b], [image_b]]
+        serving = handler([[0.0] * 255, [0.0] * 255])
+        encoded = iter(
+            [([10, 11], [1000, 1001], images[0]), ([12], [1001, 1000], images[1])]
+        )
+        asyncio.run(serving._score_compact_decider(encoded, None))
+        request = serving.tokenizer_manager.requests[0]
+        self.assertEqual(request.image_data, images)
+        request.normalize_batch_and_arguments()
+        self.assertEqual(request[0].image_data, images[0])
+        self.assertEqual(request[1].image_data, images[1])
+
+    def test_systemone_response_uses_existing_answer_shapes_and_confidence(self):
+        row = [0.0, 2.0, -2.0] + [1000.0] * 252
+        serving = handler([row, row, row])
+        request = SystemOneRequest(
+            model="pplx",
+            state="ticket",
+            questions={
+                "team": {
+                    "type": "choice",
+                    "criteria": {"billing": None, "support": None},
+                },
+                "urgent": {"type": "noul", "instructions": "Urgent?"},
+                "severity": {"type": "score", "criteria": ["low", "medium", "high"]},
+            },
+        )
+        encoded = iter(
+            [
+                ([1], [1000, 1001], []),
+                ([2], [1001, 1000], []),
+                ([3], [1000, 1001, 1002], []),
+            ]
+        )
+        views = [_view(q) for q in request.questions.values()]
+        response = asyncio.run(
+            serving._handle_non_streaming_request(encoded, (request, views), None)
+        )
+        body = json.loads(response.body)
+        self.assertEqual(body["answers"]["team"]["choice"], "support")
+        self.assertAlmostEqual(
+            body["answers"]["urgent"]["noul"], math.exp(1) / (1 + math.exp(1))
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(body["usage"]["input_tokens"], 63)
+        self.assertEqual(body["usage"]["output_tokens"], 0)
+        self.assertIn("confidence", body["answers"]["severity"])
+        for answer in body["answers"].values():
+            self.assertNotIn("x_label_mass", answer)
+
+    def test_disabled_mode_still_calls_the_existing_scorer(self):
+        serving = handler([])
+        serving.compact_decision_readout = False
+        serving._score = mock.AsyncMock(
+            return_value=(
+                [],
+                [],
+                SimpleNamespace(
+                    scores=[[0.25, 0.75]],
+                    token_logprobs=[[-2.0, -1.0]],
+                    prompt_tokens=12,
+                ),
+            )
+        )
+        serving._score_compact_decider = mock.AsyncMock(
+            side_effect=AssertionError("compact path used")
+        )
+        request = SystemOneRequest(
+            model="pplx",
+            state="ticket",
+            questions={"ok": {"type": "noul", "instructions": "OK?"}},
+        )
+        response = asyncio.run(
+            serving._handle_non_streaming_request(
+                iter([]), (request, [_view(request.questions["ok"])]), None
+            )
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(json.loads(response.body)["answers"]["ok"]["noul"], 0.25)
+        serving._score.assert_awaited_once()
+        serving._score_compact_decider.assert_not_awaited()
+
+    def test_generation_refused_before_model_execution_but_health_embedding_allowed(
+        self,
+    ):
+        manager = SimpleNamespace(
+            model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                compact_decision_readout=True, joint_head_config=None
+            )
+        )
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "do not generate"):
+            TokenizerManager._validate_joint_schema_request(
+                manager, GenerateReqInput(input_ids=[1]), [1]
+            )
+        TokenizerManager._validate_joint_schema_request(
+            manager, EmbeddingReqInput(input_ids=[1]), [1]
+        )
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "last-token"):
+            TokenizerManager._validate_joint_schema_request(
+                manager,
+                EmbeddingReqInput(input_ids=[1], token_indices_to_pool=[0]),
+                [1],
+            )
+
+    def test_raw_score_cannot_silently_ignore_vocabulary_labels(self):
+        manager = SimpleNamespace(
+            is_generation=False,
+            model_config=SimpleNamespace(compact_decision_readout=True),
+        )
+        for kwargs in (
+            {"label_token_ids": [1000, 1001]},
+            {"apply_softmax": True},
+            {"score_extraction_token_id": 7},
+            {"return_token_logprobs": True},
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(kwargs), self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "raw logits"):
+                asyncio.run(
+                    TokenizerManagerScoreMixin.score_request(
+                        manager, items=[[1]], **kwargs
+                    )
+                )
+
+    def test_invalid_calibration_and_wrong_readout_shape_are_rejected(self):
+        serving = handler([[0.0] * 254])
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "number of codes"):
+            asyncio.run(
+                serving._score_compact_decider(iter([([1], [1000, 1001], [])]), None)
+            )
+        serving.decision_config["temperature"] = 0.0
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "temperature"):
+            asyncio.run(
+                serving._score_compact_decider(iter([([1], [1000, 1001], [])]), None)
+            )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""CPU tests for the PPLX readout's allocation and numerical contract."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.compact_decision_head import CompactDecisionPooler
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=3, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestCompactDecisionPooler(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_pools_before_scoring_a_variable_length_batch(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(7)
+        pooler = CompactDecisionPooler(11, 255)
+        hidden = torch.randn(10, 11)
+        batch = SimpleNamespace(
+            extend_seq_lens=torch.tensor([3, 5, 2]),
+            return_pooled_hidden_states=True,
+        )
+        shapes = []
+        pooler.readout.register_forward_pre_hook(
+            lambda module, args: shapes.append(tuple(args[0].shape))
+        )
+        result = pooler(hidden, batch)
+        last = hidden[[2, 7, 9]]
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            result.embeddings, nn.functional.linear(last, pooler.readout.weight)
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(result.pooled_hidden_states, last)
+        self.assertEqual(shapes, [(3, 11)])
+        self.assertEqual(tuple(result.embeddings.shape), (3, 255))
+
+    def test_production_head_size_has_no_vocabulary_padding(self):
+        with torch.device("meta"):
+            pooler = CompactDecisionPooler(5120, 255)
+        self.assertEqual(list(dict(pooler.named_parameters())), ["readout.weight"])
+        self.assertEqual(pooler.readout.weight.numel(), 255 * 5120)
+        self.assertIsNone(pooler.readout.bias)
+
+    def test_candidate_probabilities_equal_the_scattered_head_reference(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(19)
+        pooler = CompactDecisionPooler(9, 255).double()
+        hidden = torch.randn(4, 9, dtype=torch.float64)
+        token_ids = torch.randperm(1024)[:255]
+        expanded = torch.zeros(1024, 9, dtype=torch.float64)
+        expanded[token_ids] = pooler.readout.weight
+        full_logp = torch.log_softmax(hidden @ expanded.T, dim=-1)
+        compact = pooler.readout(hidden)
+        for count in (2, 3, 26, 255):
+            for temperature in (0.6, 1.0087417621345625, 2.0):
+                expected = torch.softmax(
+                    full_logp[:, token_ids[:count]] / temperature, dim=-1
+                )
+                actual = torch.softmax(compact[:, :count] / temperature, dim=-1)
+                torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-12)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
